situations.title: SAT·SBT 개념·일정 이해
situations.tagline: The team mentioned an SAT and SBT for him today — what does that mean?
situations.brief: 진정중단과 자발호흡 시험의 개념과 일정을 가족에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: First we pause his sedation to see how awake he can get.
Then we let him breathe on his own for a trial to test his readiness.
These daily checks help us know when he can come off the ventilator.

situations.title: 이탈 준비도 스크리닝
situations.tagline: Can you help me run through the weaning screen on this patient?
situations.brief: 산소, 혈역학, 의식 기준으로 이탈 준비도를 스크리닝하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's check if his oxygen requirement is low enough to wean.
His blood pressure is stable without pressors, so that criterion is met.
He's following commands, which tells us his mental status is adequate.

situations.title: SBT 중 호흡양상 관찰
situations.tagline: He's on his breathing trial now — his rate looks a little fast to me, is that failing?
situations.brief: SBT 중 호흡양상을 관찰해 실패 징후를 인지하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm watching his rate, effort, and oxygen during the trial.
A rising rate with accessory muscle use can signal he's tiring.
If he shows distress, we'll stop the trial and rest him.
goals: SBT 중 실패 징후를 조기에 인지한다

situations.title: 발관 전 커프리크 확인
situations.tagline: You're checking for a cuff leak — what does that tell us about him?
situations.brief: 커프리크를 확인해 상기도 부종 위험을 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm deflating the cuff to check for airflow around the tube.
A good leak suggests his airway isn't too swollen for extubation.
This helps us make sure he can breathe once the tube is out.

situations.title: 발관 물품·산소 준비
situations.tagline: Do you want me to set up the high-flow and NIV before we extubate?
situations.brief: 발관에 대비해 HFNC와 NIV를 포함한 물품과 산소를 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's have the high-flow cannula ready at the bedside.
Set up NIV as a backup in case he needs more support.
I'll confirm suction and the reintubation kit are within reach.

situations.title: 분비물·기침력 사정
situations.tagline: Before we pull the tube, how are his secretions and cough looking?
situations.brief: 분비물 양과 기침력을 사정해 기도 청결 능력을 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: His secretions are minimal and clear right now.
He has a strong cough, so he can protect his own airway.
Weak cough or heavy secretions would make me cautious about extubating.

situations.title: SBT 실패 원인 감별
situations.tagline: He didn't tolerate the trial again — was it his heart, his lungs, or just anxiety?
situations.brief: 심장, 호흡, 불안 원인을 구분해 SBT 실패 원인을 감별하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's sort out whether this is cardiac, respiratory, or anxiety-driven.
His blood pressure and heart rate spiked, which points to a cardiac cause.
I'll report the pattern so we can adjust the weaning plan.
goals: 감별 결과를 팀과 소통해 계획을 조정한다

situations.title: 진정 중단 안전 수행
situations.tagline: We're pausing his sedation now — can you help me watch him closely?
situations.brief: 각성과 안전을 감시하며 진정 중단을 안전하게 수행하세요.
keyPhrases: We're holding sedation to see how he wakes up.
Watch for agitation so he doesn't pull at his lines.
If he becomes unsafe or unstable, we'll restart sedation at half dose.
goals: 진정 중단 중 각성 수준을 안전하게 감시한다
위험 징후 시 재개 기준을 적용한다

situations.title: 발관 후 HFNC 전환 관리
situations.tagline: Now that the tube's out, is the high-flow enough to keep him breathing okay?
situations.brief: 발관 후 예방적 HFNC로 전환하고 반응을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: The high-flow gives him warm oxygen and gentle support without a tube.
I'm watching his breathing rate and oxygen to make sure it's enough.
This helps prevent him from needing the tube back in.
goals: 발관 후 HFNC 전환의 목적을 이해한다

situations.title: 발관 후 예방 NIV 적용
situations.tagline: The mask went on right after the tube came out — is something going wrong already?
situations.brief: 고위험군에 발관 후 예방 NIV를 적용하고 목적을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The mask is a preventive step, not a sign that he's failing.
Because he's higher risk, this support helps him avoid reintubation.
I'll adjust the fit so it's comfortable and sealing well.
goals: 발관 후 예방 NIV의 적응증을 이해한다

situations.title: 재삽관 위험 평가·소통
situations.tagline: How likely is it that he'll need the tube back in?
situations.brief: 위험인자를 평가해 재삽관 위험을 판단하고 팀에 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: His risk factors include weak cough and a prolonged intubation.
I'd put him in the higher-risk category for reintubation.
I'll flag this to the team so we watch him closely tonight.

situations.title: 흡기근 약화 재활 연계
situations.tagline: He seems so weak — will he ever get the strength back to breathe on his own?
situations.brief: 조기 이동과 근력 강화를 위해 흡기근 약화 재활을 연계하세요.
keyPhrases: His breathing muscles weaken after being on the vent for a while.
Getting him moving early helps rebuild that strength.
We'll bring in physical therapy to work on his breathing muscles.
goals: 흡기근 약화의 원인과 재활 방법을 설명한다

situations.title: 기관절개 전환 시점 논의
situations.tagline: They're talking about a tracheostomy now — does that mean he's not getting better?
situations.brief: 장기 환기에 대비해 기관절개 전환 시점을 가족과 논의하세요.
keyPhrases: A tracheostomy can actually make him more comfortable for longer support.
It doesn't mean he's failing, it means we're planning for the longer road.
It often makes weaning and communication easier for him.

situations.title: 발관 지연 원인 문서화
situations.tagline: Can you note why we're holding off on extubation so the whole team's on the same page?
situations.brief: 다학제 소통을 위해 발관 지연 원인을 명확히 문서화하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll document that extubation is delayed due to heavy secretions.
Clear notes help the next shift understand the plan.
Let's make sure the reason is in the chart for the whole team.

situations.title: 섬망·불안으로 인한 이탈 지연
situations.tagline: He gets so agitated and confused every time we try to wean — what can we do without more drugs?
situations.brief: 비약물 중재로 섬망과 불안으로 인한 이탈 지연을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's try reorienting him and bringing family to the bedside.
Reducing noise and keeping a day-night routine can calm his delirium.
Non-drug measures first can help him tolerate weaning better.
goals: 이탈 지연을 완화하는 환경 조정을 시행한다

situations.title: 발관 후 상기도 부종 stridor 위기
situations.tagline: He's making a high-pitched sound and struggling to breathe — that's stridor, isn't it?
situations.brief: 상기도 부종 stridor에 대응해 에피네프린 분무와 재삽관을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: That stridor means his upper airway is swelling and narrowing.
Give nebulized epinephrine and call the airway team now.
Have the reintubation cart ready in case he obstructs.
goals: 발관 후 stridor의 위기 징후를 인지한다
에피 분무와 재삽관 준비를 신속히 시행한다

situations.title: 발관 실패 응급 재삽관
situations.tagline: He's not maintaining his airway — we need to reintubate right now, get the cart!
situations.brief: 발관 실패 시 신속히 기도를 재확보하고 재삽관을 보조하세요.
keyPhrases: Bag him with 100 percent oxygen while we prepare to reintubate.
I've got the tube, laryngoscope, and suction ready.
Call the physician to the bedside stat for the airway.
goals: 발관 실패 시 즉시 산소화를 유지한다

situations.title: 발관 직후 호흡부전 급변
situations.tagline: He looked fine and now he's crashing — do we try the mask or go straight to the tube?
situations.brief: 발관 직후 호흡부전 급변에서 구조 NIV와 재삽관을 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: If he's alert with a manageable airway, we can trial rescue NIV briefly.
But if he keeps deteriorating, we reintubate without delay.
Let's set a short time limit so we don't lose the window.
goals: 발관 직후 급변에서 구조 NIV 적응을 판단한다

situations.title: 반복 SBT 실패 장기 이탈
situations.tagline: He keeps failing these trials over and over — where do we go from here?
situations.brief: 반복 SBT 실패 시 계획을 재수립하고 기관절개를 논의하세요.
keyPhrases: He's failed repeated trials, so we need a longer-term weaning plan.
Let's discuss a tracheostomy to support a gradual wean.
I'll bring the multidisciplinary team together to reset the goals.
goals: 반복 SBT 실패에서 이탈 계획을 재수립한다

situations.title: 이탈 중 심근허혈 유발
situations.tagline: His EKG changed and he's having chest tightness during the wean — I think we're stressing his heart.
situations.brief: weaning-induced ischemia에 대응해 이탈을 중단하고 심장을 보호하세요.
keyPhrases: The weaning is increasing his cardiac workload and causing ischemia.
Let's put him back on full support to rest his heart.
I'll get a twelve-lead and notify the physician right away.

situations.title: 발관 후 흡인 기도폐색 위기
situations.tagline: He aspirated and now he can't clear it — his airway's blocking, help me suction him!
situations.brief: 발관 후 흡인으로 인한 기도폐색에 즉각 흡인과 기도확보로 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Suction him aggressively to clear the aspirated material now.
Turn him on his side and give high-flow oxygen.
If he obstructs completely, we prepare to reintubate immediately.
goals: 발관 후 흡인 기도폐색에 즉각 흡인으로 대응한다
